about: Summoner's Rift changes from Riot's patch notes (and the next patch's preview): champion changes, and system changes (items, runes) that move every champion who uses them. Kinds: buff, nerf, adjust (mixed or a rework). Edit this file when a patch ships; the tier board reads it at startup.
